claim: The 31 reports are machine-ready and expose row-level fresh-context receipts, but an adversarial recheck found substantive false-negative candidates hidden by repeated generic closure reasons. The month-level semantic acceptance therefore cannot stand without a new full replay.

evidence.challenge_count_boundary: A keyword-triggered challenge is not a confirmed candidate and must not be promoted without full title+abstract semantic review. It only proves that the prior generic closure cannot be accepted without re-reading.

findings.title: Omni-Diffusion: Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation with Masked Discrete Diffusion
findings.why_reopen: The abstract proposes an any-to-any multimodal foundation model whose backbone and joint factorization use masked discrete diffusion across text, speech and images. That directly challenges the long-term MULTIMODAL-GENERATIVE-PARADIGMS branch and cannot be closed as merely a local model/task method without exact-v1 review.

findings.title: Multimodal Large Language Models as Image Classifiers
findings.why_reopen: The abstract identifies protocol and ground-truth defects that reverse reported conclusions and shows sensitivity to batch size, image order and output mapping. This can alter the canonical evaluation contract and requires at least a candidate-level Source Review.

findings.description: Many closure rows repeat generic phrases such as 'local model/task method' without explaining why the paper's stated mechanism fails each denominator criterion. The two confirmed counterexamples show that row count equality alone did not provide a sound semantic audit.
Promoted false negatives can change Score V2 routes, top-three analysis selection, Stable Node ownership, and Books dispositions.

required_resolution: A fresh-context reviewer who did not author the reports must re-read all 15,178 title+abstract rows; keyword challenges are prioritization aids, not semantic decisions.
Every retained/promoted family must receive exact-v1 withdrawal check, Score V2, route-specific Source Review, Books comparison and final disposition.
Recompute each affected denominator and all four Semantic Audit scopes before restoring Complete.

materials_request.reason: Primary inventories are locally available; the blocker is invalid semantic acceptance, not missing user material.
